title: Compact start works
moves: Avenue, 6 streets, 3 cross streets, neighbor link
happened: Built the whole starter block on day one with a $10,000 bond: thin bands of homes, shops and factories next to each other, power lines through every band. By Jan 2001: 1,650 people (attempt 1 had 20) and only 7% unemployed.
watching: Water spare capacity (the game's graph) was already down to 21%.

title: 5,000 people in two years
happened: Population 1,650 -> 5,140 with almost no unemployment. Took a second $10,000 bond and built a second block of bands to the south.
watching: Water spare capacity; power plant capacity.

title: Power ran out
happened: Population 5,140 -> 6,630 but the one coal plant hit its limit at the end of the year; the water pumps lost power and water dropped to zero (133 abandoned buildings).

title: Recovered
moves: Factories in the south block's middle bands
happened: Second coal plant brought power and water back within two months. Population 6,630 -> 7,740. Water spare capacity was back at 0% by December.

title: 10,000 people, on pace
moves: Factories in the south middle bands
happened: Population 7,740 -> 10,670, right on the straight-line pace to 100,000. Water spare capacity kept running out; 32 more pumps and a third coal plant kept up. Unemployment 9-15%.
watching: Room to grow: the starter blocks are nearly full.

title: +37%: 14,660 people
happened: The east block filled fast: population 10,670 -> 14,660, unemployment 5%, abandoned buildings halved (137 -> 75). Power spare fell to 18% and traffic jams appeared (27 tiles).

title: 19,000 people, ahead of pace
happened: Population 14,660 -> 19,020 (+30%), unemployment 3%. A fourth coal plant and east-lake pumps kept power and water up.

title: 25,000 people
happened: Population 19,020 -> 25,670 (+35%), unemployment 3%. The south block filled quickly. But power was at 6% spare and only 47% of buildings had water by January.

title: Power and water wiring problems
happened: Population 25,670 -> 28,920 (+13%), slower. Most pumps had no power because of broken power-line junctions; fixing them took water from 47% to 99% of buildings. Power lines drawn over zones get replaced by buildings, which cut off the south; a sixth coal plant there brought power back to 97%.
watching: Growth in the south block now that it has power.

title: 30,000 people
happened: With power back in the south block the city passed 30,000 by spring.

title: 35,690 people, budget positive
happened: Population about 30,650 -> 35,690. Tax income (,330) now covers bond payments (,299) with room to spare. Home demand fell to almost zero while shop and factory demand stayed maxed; power spare down to 10%.
watching: Shops in the new north district; power; first police and fire stations.

title: First decline
moves: Feeder power line to the north
happened: Population 35,690 -> 34,450. Home demand turned negative; 403 abandoned, mostly homes. North district had no power until a feeder line was run along the map edge.
watching: Jobs: every factory tile is built.

title: Jobs shortage
moves: Factory land: north strip + river strip
happened: Population 34,450 -> 31,720, unemployment 18%, 709 abandoned (643 of them homes). Every factory tile was built, so new factory land was zoned in the north strip and between the river and the avenue. Ninth bond, tax 8%. The southeast corner stayed unpowered despite an eighth coal plant.
watching: Whether the new factory land brings jobs.
